readerCopy.body: An old power struggle can return because some part of it still controls your choices. Pluto conjunct the South Node can bring a familiar obsession, authority dynamic, fear, or need for control back to the surface with unusual force. You may recognize the person, pattern, or feeling immediately, even if the circumstances are different. The repetition is useful because it shows where the past still has leverage. You do not have to win the old battle again to take that leverage back.
